description.text: The School's Chinese Language Training program is designed to provide long-term or short-term Chinese language teaching for foreigners who wish to improve their comprehensive Chinese language skills or for international students applying to study medicine at Ningxia Medical University. This program is based on the intensive teaching mode of small classes, so that international students can understand and integrate into Chinese culture in a short time, and have different levels of Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing skills, and lay a good language foundation for future study and life in China.

duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Language Course at Ningxia Medical University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1388 USD/per year ￥ 10000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 3. At least 60% score in science subjects: Mathematics, English, Biology, Physics and Chemistry. 4. Have basic English language ability;
